note: One catalogue for the four SDKs (NAMING.md section 7). Every SDK embeds this file and a test fails when its copy differs. `message` may contain {placeholders} the SDK fills; `fix` is one sentence a developer can act on; the docs link is docs_base + code. `server_rejected` has `reasons`: when the server's 403 carries one of those codes, the error's message and fix are that reason's (the code stays `server_rejected`).

errors.message: Invalid argument: {detail}.
errors.fix: Pass a value the API accepts: a context or head name the model lists, a sample rate the SDK can resample, a surah from 1 to 114 with ayahs inside it, a rule name of lower-case letters, digits and underscores.

errors.message: Quran Lab does not accept this key.
errors.fix: Copy the key for this app and platform again from sdk.quranlab.ai; a revoked key has to be replaced by a new one there.

errors.message: This key needs SDK {version} or later; this is {sdk}.
errors.fix: Upgrade the TajweedFormer SDK to {version} or later (the min_sdk of the server's answer), with the install line of the README.

errors.message: Quran Lab refused this app: {detail}.
errors.fix: Check in sdk.quranlab.ai that the key belongs to this app id and platform and that the app is not blocked.

developer_not_approved.message: The account behind this key has no access to Quran Lab yet (developer_not_approved).
developer_not_approved.fix: Open https://sdk.quranlab.ai/start with the account that owns the key and finish the access request; the key works as soon as access is given.

not_a_member.message: The account that made this key is not a member of the workspace that owns the app (not_a_member).
not_a_member.fix: Ask an owner of that workspace on sdk.quranlab.ai to add the account, or make a new key from an account that is a member.

key_type_mismatch.message: This key is of the wrong type for this platform (key_type_mismatch).
key_type_mismatch.fix: Use an apps key on Android and iOS, a desktop key on macOS, Windows and Linux, and a web key in a browser page; sdk.quranlab.ai makes each of them under the same app.

origin_not_allowed.message: This page's origin, {origin}, is not on the key (origin_not_allowed).
origin_not_allowed.fix: Add this page's origin (scheme, host and port, for example https://app.example.org) to the key on its page at https://sdk.quranlab.ai/keys.

app_not_allowed.message: This key belongs to another app (app_not_allowed).
app_not_allowed.fix: A key works for the first app that used it. Make a key for this app at https://sdk.quranlab.ai/keys, or allow this app's identifier on the key's page.

app_blocked.message: Quran Lab has blocked this app (app_blocked).
app_blocked.fix: Open the app's page on sdk.quranlab.ai for the reason, or write to Quran Lab from the account that owns the app.

environment_mismatch.message: This key's environment (development or production) does not match this app (environment_mismatch).
environment_mismatch.fix: Use the development key in the builds you run yourself and the production key in the build you publish; both are on the app's page on sdk.quranlab.ai.

local_needs_development_key.message: This page runs on {origin}, and a production key does not work on a local address (local_needs_development_key).
local_needs_development_key.fix: Use this app's development key for local work, with http://localhost:* among its origins (https://sdk.quranlab.ai/keys); keep the production key for the deployed site.

errors.message: This process already has a TajweedClient.
errors.fix: Keep the first client and reuse it, or close it before making another.

errors.message: Quran Lab has no model build for SDK {sdk} yet.
errors.fix: Nothing to change in the app: call model() again later, and check client.diagnose() and sdk.quranlab.ai for the model builds of this SDK version.

errors.message: The model is not on this device yet.
errors.fix: Connect once so the model can be downloaded; call prefetch() at app start so later starts work offline.

errors.message: This app is not allowed to use the network.
errors.fix: Android: keep the INTERNET permission that the SDK's manifest declares (take out a tools:node="remove" for android.permission.INTERNET). A sandboxed Mac app: turn on Outgoing Connections (Client) under App Sandbox.

errors.message: The model download stopped: {detail}.
errors.fix: Call model() or prefetch() again when the network is back; the download resumes where it stopped.

errors.message: Not enough free space for the model: {needed} bytes needed, {available} free.
errors.fix: Free that much space on the device, or call removeModels() to drop model versions that are no longer used.

errors.message: The SDK's folder cannot be read or written: {detail}.
errors.fix: Give the client a storage folder the app can write to, and make sure only one process uses it.

errors.message: No model here: {detail}.
errors.fix: Open a folder that holds a model's manifest.json and files, or let client.model() download it.

errors.message: The model folder is damaged: {detail}.
errors.fix: Call removeModels() and then model() to download the model again.

errors.message: The model's manifest is not signed by Quran Lab.
errors.fix: Use only model files from cdn.quranlab.ai; call removeModels() and then model() to download them again.

errors.message: A model file differs from the manifest: {file}.
errors.fix: Call removeModels() and then model() to download the model again; if it repeats, the storage is failing.

errors.message: This model build does not run on this SDK: {detail}.
errors.fix: Upgrade the SDK to the version the message names, or let client.model() pick the build for this SDK instead of opening a folder.

errors.message: The SDK cannot run here: {detail}.
errors.fix: Run the app where the SDK is supported: {minimum}.

errors.message: The reference data is not on this device.
errors.fix: Call model.reference.fetch() once, with a connection, before asking for units.

errors.message: This model already has an open session.
errors.fix: Finish or cancel the open session before starting the next take.

errors.message: The session has ended.
errors.fix: Start a new session with model.listen() or model.session() for the next take.

errors.message: The take was cancelled.
errors.fix: Nothing to fix: cancel() was called, or the app's task was cancelled; start a new session for the next take.

errors.message: The engine failed: {detail}.
errors.fix: Call client.diagnose() and send the report to Quran Lab; a new session on the same model can be tried.

errors.message: The microphone permission was refused.
errors.fix: Explain why the app listens and send the learner to the system settings; listen() asks again only where the platform allows it.

errors.message: No microphone can be opened: {detail}.
errors.fix: Check that the device has an input and no other app holds it, then call listen() again.

errors.message: The take ended on an interruption: {detail}.
errors.fix: Start a new session when the app has the audio again; what was heard so far is in the last chunk.

errors.message: Sharing is not available for this app.
errors.fix: Nothing to call: Quran Lab switches sharing on per app; check client.sharing.isAvailable before showing sharing settings.
